title: VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Broken FileDialog Graphics on Haswell Vulkan
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.5-beta4 (https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-5-beta-4/) - Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable.arch_linux (https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/godot/-/commit/b00cfdc0e9beccaed07fdb67833ed237d994bde9) - Reproducible in 4.4-dev1 (https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.4-dev1/) - Not reproducible in 4.3-stable (https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.3-stable/) ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 29 Jul 2025 15:21:52 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 4400 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4300U CPU @ 1.90GHz (4 threads) ### Issue description **Note: I am aware this could be a bug in Haswell Vulkan. However, in this case enabling driver validation sometimes masks the issue, so this looks more like a Vulkan API usage bug rather than a driver bug.** Open file dialog UI is broken: Working as expected by switching to `--rendering-driver opengl3`. ### Steps to reproduce - Enable Vulkan Forward+ renderer - Open file dialog, note the artifacts/broken interface Validation log after opening file dialog: ``` ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 0 vkCreateImage(): The following VkImageCreateInfo returned VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED when calling vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2 format (VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) type (VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D) tiling (VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL) usage (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT|VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT|VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT|VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT) flags (VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT) pNext chain: VkImageCreateInfo::pNext -> [VkImageFormatListCreateInfo]. The Vulkan spec states: Each of the following values (as described in Image Creation Limits) must not be undefined : imageCreateMaxMipLevels, imageCreateMaxArrayLayers, imageCreateMaxExtent, and imageCreateSampleCounts (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html#VUID-VkImageCreateInfo-imageCreateMaxMipLevels-02251) at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665) Vulkan Debug Report: object - 96666505524288 ``` Full 4.4.1.stable.arch_linux validation log from `VK_LAYER_VALIDATE_SYNC=1 godot --path . --gpu-validation`: [validation-log.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21559929/validation-log.txt) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [filepicker.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21559930/filepicker.zip)
